observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== availability/restart config for the 5 down services ==="
for s in plausibility-notes fpp comment jura-db gesetzesbegruendung-db; do
  ln=$(grep -n "^  $s:" process-compose.yaml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  end=$(awk -v l=$ln 'NR>l && /^  [a-z0-9_-]+:\s*$/ {print NR; exit}' process-compose.yaml)
  [ -z "$end" ] && end=$((ln+40))
  echo "--- $s (lines $ln-$end) ---"
  sed -n "${ln},${end}p" process-compose.yaml | grep -E "availability|restart|backoff|one_shot|long_running" 
done
